world.title: Pakistani Man Jailed For 27 Years In US For Trump Murder Plot
world.summary: Asif Merchant, a Pakistani man, was sentenced to over 27 years in prison for plotting to assassinate former President Donald Trump. A Brooklyn court found that he sought to hire a hitman to target a U.S. politician or government official. The plot was reportedly in retaliation for the U.S. killing of Iranian Revolutionary Guards commander Qassem Soleimani.

world.title: Kuwait, Bahrain fend off Iranian aerial attacks as Coalition hits Houthi military sites
world.summary: Kuwait and Bahrain successfully repelled Iranian aerial attacks on Wednesday, amid increased tensions in the Gulf region. In response, a Coalition launched strikes that destroyed 60 Houthi military targets across Yemen. The developments highlight the ongoing conflict involving Iran and its regional adversaries, as well as the Coalition's efforts to counter Houthi threats in the area.

world.title: Hung Cao Senate hearing: Democrats raise Navy suicides and Iran war
world.summary: During a Senate hearing, Senator Kirsten Gillibrand questioned acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao regarding a sailor who went overboard from a US aircraft carrier, raising concerns about military mental health and suicide attempts. The discussion intensified scrutiny on recruitment challenges and the implications of the ongoing Iran war, highlighting the need for improved support for service members.

business.title: Stocks in News: Tata Group companies, Bharti Airtel, HCL Tech, Groww, IIFL Finance, ACME Solar
business.summary: Stocks of Tata Group companies, Bharti Airtel, HCLTech, Groww, IIFL Finance, and ACME Solar Holdings are expected to attract attention on Wednesday, November 18. Investors will monitor company-specific developments and corporate announcements that may impact these stocks. The market's focus on these companies indicates potential volatility and interest in their performance amid ongoing economic conditions.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Before Going Into Trade On Nov 18
business.summary: Indian benchmark indices, the Sensex and Nifty 50, continued their positive momentum as of November 18. Key stocks are in focus, along with significant brokerage recommendations and comprehensive trade setups. Market participants are advised to stay informed about the latest developments and trends in the stock market to make informed trading decisions throughout the day.

business.title: 'Board accepted his resignation': Nvidia chairman rules out Jensen Huang's return; company doubles revenue
business.summary: Nvidia chairman Harvey Jones confirmed on Tuesday that the board will not reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, following his resignation. The company reported a significant increase in revenue, doubling year-on-year. This announcement comes amid Nvidia's ongoing growth and success in the technology sector, highlighting the company's strong financial performance despite the leadership change.

technology.title: What your love of spicy food might reveal about your personality
technology.summary: A systematic review of 58 studies indicates that personality traits like sensation seeking and emotional states influence spicy food preferences. Consuming spicy foods may temporarily impact risk-taking and aggression-related thinking. Researchers suggest that sensory adaptation and rewarding experiences reinforce these preferences over time, though evidence for lasting psychological changes remains limited, highlighting the complex relationship between food and personality.

technology.title: Xbox Announces Official Black Friday Sale on Digital Games and Accessories - But No Consoles
technology.summary: Xbox has announced its Black Friday sale, starting November 19 at 9am PST. The sale features discounts of up to 80% on digital Xbox and PC games, along with various accessories. However, no consoles will be included in the promotions. This announcement follows similar sales from Nintendo and PlayStation, highlighting the competitive holiday shopping season.

sports.title: Rodri: Winning the Champions League is the objective, but Barcelona are not favorites
sports.summary: Rodri emphasized that winning the Champions League is the team's main objective, but he does not consider Barcelona as favorites. He stated that objectives differ from labels and that Barcelona aims to compete for all titles. Rodri aims to maintain calm within the group, reminding them that it is still early in the season and expectations should be managed.

sports.title: Stoppage-time drama: Haaland embarrasses Mbappé with a frightening record!
sports.summary: Erling Haaland led Norway to a 3-2 victory over Denmark in the UEFA Nations League, scoring twice, including a last-minute penalty. This performance secured Norway's place in the quarter-finals. Haaland's achievement highlighted his growing prominence in international football, contrasting with fellow star Kylian Mbappé. The match showcased Haaland's ability to deliver under pressure in crucial moments.

sports.title: Erling Haaland sends Norway to Nations League quarterfinals
sports.summary: Erling Haaland scored a decisive penalty in the final moments, leading Norway to a 3-2 victory over Denmark. This win secured Norway's advancement to the Nations League quarterfinals. The match was crucial for both teams, with Haaland's performance highlighting his significance to the squad. Norway's progression marks an important achievement in their Nations League campaign.

health.title: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs linked to inadequate intake of key nutrients in some people
health.summary: A small exploratory study published in BMJ Nutrition Prevention & Health indicates that appetite-suppressing drugs like Wegovy and Mounjaro may lead to inadequate intake of essential nutrients and energy in some individuals. The findings highlight potential nutritional deficiencies associated with these weight-loss medications, suggesting that users should be monitored for their dietary intake while using such treatments.

health.title: Older Immigrants at Increased Risk as US Loses Measles Elimination Status
health.summary: The US lost its measles elimination status on November 17 due to ongoing virus spread for over a year. Older adults, particularly immigrants who may lack childhood vaccinations, are at heightened risk for measles infections. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reported 5,412 confirmed cases as of November, highlighting the vulnerability of this demographic.

health.title: Can Diabetes Before Pregnancy Affect a Baby’s Heart?
health.summary: A study analyzing over 44 million births indicates that preexisting diabetes significantly increases the risk of congenital heart defects in newborns, with a 48% higher relative risk identified. Researchers emphasize the importance of early prenatal care, as a baby's heart begins developing before pregnancy is often recognized. These findings highlight potential implications for maternal health and infant outcomes.

science.title: November’s sky has a full supermoon on November 24 that starts a run of three, the Leonid meteor shower peaking before dawn on November 17 and 18, and Taurid showers known for bright fireballs, NASA s
science.summary: November features a full supermoon on the 24th, marking the beginning of three consecutive supermoons. The Leonid meteor shower will peak before dawn on November 17 and 18, while the Taurid meteor showers are noted for their bright fireballs. NASA highlights these celestial events, showcasing the ongoing mysteries of the universe that continue to intrigue humanity.

science.title: How far is a light-day? NASA's Voyager 1 probe nears milestone
science.summary: NASA's Voyager 1 probe is approaching a significant milestone, expected to cross a light-day from Earth on Wednesday morning. This distance will place it over 58 billion Empire State Buildings away from our planet, marking it as the most distant human-made object in space. Voyager 1 was launched nearly 50 years ago and continues its journey through the cosmos.

science.title: Gravitational waves point to black holes without supernovae
science.summary: An analysis of 257 black hole mergers has identified a population of black holes potentially formed through the direct collapse of massive stars, bypassing supernova explosions. This finding, based on gravitational-wave signals, suggests an alternative formation pathway for these cosmic objects. The study was published in the journal Physical Review, highlighting significant implications for our understanding of black hole formation.
